DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードをなくされたのですね。どちらの口座のカードですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have lost your card, I see. Which account was the card for?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いつもこの近くのATMを使っています。こちらの銀行のカードだと思って、停止をお願いしに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: よく使うATMを基に来店銀行へカード停止を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I always use the ATM near here. I thought my card was from this bank, so I came to ask you to block it.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the bank you have visited to block your card, based on the ATM you often use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ATMの設置場所とカードの発行銀行は同じとは限りません。通帳など、銀行名が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The bank that issued your card is not necessarily the bank where the ATM is located. Do you have a passbook or anything showing the bank's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: スマホに通帳の写真があります。あ、ここには別の銀行名が書いてあります。来る所を間違えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳写真で発行銀行が別と気付き訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a photo of my passbook on my phone. Oh, it shows a different bank's name here. I came to the wrong place.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice from the passbook photo that a different bank issued the card, and correct yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発行した銀行へ紛失の連絡をしてください。写真には支店名も見えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please report the loss to the bank that issued it. I can see the branch name in the photo too.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この支店です。検索で出てきた電話番号をすぐ使うより、公式の案内から連絡先を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行支店を示し公式資料で連絡先を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is this branch. Rather than immediately using a phone number from search results, I would like to check the contact details in official information.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the issuing branch and say you want to check its contact details in official materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の銀行の公式サイトや手元の案内をご覧ください。こちらで別の銀行のカードを停止することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check your bank's official website or the information you have. We cannot block another bank's card here.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。ここで停止済みにはならないんですね。外へ出て、発行銀行へ連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来店先では停止済みにならないと確認して発行銀行へ連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. So the card has not been blocked by my coming here. I will go outside and contact the issuing bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the bank you have visited has not blocked the card, and say you will contact the issuing bank. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手元の銀行名と口座の資料をご用意ください。暗証番号は人前で読み上げないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have the bank's name and your account documents ready. Please do not read your PIN aloud in front of others.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 銀行名を確認して公式の連絡先へ電話します。最後に使ったATMの場所も、発行銀行へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい銀行へ資料と最後の利用ATMを説明すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the bank's name and call its official contact number. I will also tell the issuing bank where the ATM I last used is.
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to give the correct bank your account information and the location of the ATM you last used. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その銀行へ紛失の相談をお願いします。お手元の資料を忘れずにお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-GNM-TAKASAKI-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please consult that bank about the lost card. Remember to take your documents with you.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。見学のご予定で、何か相談したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you would like to discuss about your visit?

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ベビーカーで来ました。旭川の動物園を全部回る時間はないので、入口に戻りやすい経路を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ベビーカーで短時間だけ見学するので、入口に戻りやすい経路を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have brought a stroller. I do not have time to go around the whole zoo in Asahikawa, so I would like advice on a route that makes it easy to return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a route that makes it easy to return to the entrance, since you will be visiting briefly with a stroller. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 戻る時間を考えて回るんですね。何か特に見たい展示はありますか。坂や階段を避けたいご希望もありますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-03.translation: You are planning your visit with your return time in mind. Are there any exhibits you particularly want to see? Would you also prefer to avoid slopes or stairs?

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この案内図にある展示を見たいです。ただ、荷物も多いので、階段でベビーカーを持ち上げて進むことはできません。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 希望する展示を案内図で示し、荷物も多く階段でベビーカーを持ち上げられないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to see this exhibit on the map. However, I have a lot of luggage too, so I cannot carry the stroller up or down stairs to get there.
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point to the exhibit you want on the map and explain that you have a lot of luggage and cannot carry the stroller on stairs. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その展示までの通行案内を確認しましょう。地図で近く見えても、階段があるかは経路の表示を見る必要があります。帰りも同じ入口を使いますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check the access information for that exhibit. Even if it looks close on the map, we need to check the route markings for stairs. Will you use the same entrance on your way out?

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入口の外で家族と合流します。地図の細い線を近道だと思っていましたが、歩ける経路か確かめてから行きたいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ入口で家族と合流するため、図の細い線を近道と決めつけず通行できる経路か確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I will meet my family outside the entrance. I thought the thin line on the map was a shortcut, but I want to check whether it is a usable walking route before going.
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will meet your family at the same entrance and want to check whether the thin line is a usable route without assuming it is a shortcut. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 細い線だけでは通れるか判断しにくいですね。ベビーカーで通れる経路と当日の迂回表示を確認しましょう。時間が足りなければ展示を一つに絞れます。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is difficult to tell whether you can get through from a thin line alone. Let us check the stroller-accessible route and today's detour signs. If you are short of time, you can choose just one exhibit.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一つだけでも構いません。帰りが遠回りになるなら、もっと入口に近い展示に変えたいです。往復の経路を指で示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一展示だけでもよく、戻りが遠ければ入口付近の展示に変えたいので往復経路を図で示してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just one is fine. If the way back involves a long detour, I would like to choose an exhibit closer to the entrance. Could you trace the outward and return routes with your finger?
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say one exhibit is fine and ask to have the outward and return routes shown on the map, as you would prefer an exhibit near the entrance if the return route is long. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、案内図で候補を確認します。通行条件が変わっている所は、現地の表示も見てください。家族には戻る場所を具体的に伝えておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, let us look at the options on the map. Please also check the signs on site where access conditions have changed. It is reassuring to tell your family exactly where you will return.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階段を使わず往復できる候補を選び、家族に入口の待ち合わせ場所を送ります。途中で迂回が必要なら、無理に先へ進まず戻ります。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 階段を使わず往復できる候補と合流場所を確かめ、途中の迂回で難しければ無理せず戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose an option with a stair-free route both ways and send my family the meeting point at the entrance. If a detour is needed along the way, I will return instead of forcing my way onward.
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm a stair-free route both ways and the meeting point, and say you will turn back without pushing yourself if a detour makes it difficult. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず往復できる経路を一緒に確認しましょう。ベビーカーを押す際は周囲にもお気をつけて、お楽しみください。
DLG-SC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First, let us check a route you can take both ways together. Please watch your surroundings while pushing the stroller, and enjoy your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。メニューでわからないところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Welcome. Is there anything on the menu you do not understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この『濃い味』のラーメンは、麺が多いという意味ですか。旭川で食べるのは初めてで、表示の違いがよくわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ラーメンの濃い味という表示を麺の多さだと思ったので、意味を確認したいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Does 'strong flavor' on this ramen mean it has more noodles? This is my first time eating in Asahikawa, and I do not really understand the different descriptions.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought 'strong flavor' on the ramen meant more noodles, and ask what it means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 『濃い味』は量ではなく、味の強さを表す言い方です。麺の量は別の表示で確認します。量を減らしたいご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: 'Strong flavor' describes the intensity of the flavor, rather than the portion size. The noodle portion is shown separately. Would you like fewer noodles?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、少し前に軽く食べたので、麺は少なめがいいです。でも、味が濃すぎるのも苦手です。二つを同じことだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 軽く食べた後で麺は少なめがよく、味の濃さも苦手なので、量と味を別の希望として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, I had a light meal a little while ago, so I would prefer fewer noodles. But I also dislike overly strong flavors. I thought those two things meant the same thing.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain your portion and flavor preferences separately: you would like fewer noodles after a light meal and also dislike strong flavors. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 麺の量と味の調整は、別々に確認しましょう。少なめにできるかと、この料理の味を変えられるかを調理担当に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let us check the noodle portion and flavor adjustments separately. I will ask the kitchen whether they can reduce the portion and change this dish's flavor.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 味を変えられないなら、別の料理でも構いません。写真だけではわからないので、汁の味と具の内容を先に教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 味の調整ができなければ別料理でもよく、注文前に汁の味と具を説明してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: If the flavor cannot be changed, another dish is fine too. I cannot tell from the photo alone, so please explain the broth's flavor and the toppings first.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say another dish would be fine if the flavor cannot be adjusted, and ask for an explanation of the broth's flavor and toppings before ordering. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 確認できる内容をご説明します。ただ、感じる濃さには個人差があります。苦手な具があれば、それも選ぶ前にお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will explain what we can confirm. However, how strong a flavor tastes varies from person to person. Please also tell us about any toppings you dislike before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 辛い具は避けたいです。濃い味と辛い味も違うんですね。少なめの麺と、辛い具が入るかを確認してから、この料理にするか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 辛い具は避け、麺を減らせるかと具の内容を確認してから注文を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to avoid spicy toppings. So strong flavor and spicy flavor are different too. I will decide whether to order this dish after checking whether I can have fewer noodles and whether it contains spicy toppings.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid spicy toppings and decide what to order after checking whether the noodles can be reduced and what toppings are included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 調理担当に確認しました。ご覧の料理は麺を少なめにできますが、スープの味は変更できません。辛い具は入っていません。濃い味が苦手でしたら、別の料理を選ぶこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I checked with the kitchen. This dish can be served with fewer noodles, but we cannot change the broth's flavor. It has no spicy toppings. If you dislike strong flavors, you can choose another dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 味の濃さは変えられず、辛い具は入っていないと確認できました。今回はこの料理を麺少なめでお願いします。味と量を別々に伝えられました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: スープの味は変更不可で辛い具はなく麺を少なくできると確認し、この料理を麺少なめで注文すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: I have confirmed that the flavor cannot be changed and there are no spicy toppings. This time, I would like this dish with fewer noodles. I was able to explain the flavor and portion separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm that the broth's flavor cannot be changed, there are no spicy toppings, and the noodles can be reduced, then order this dish with fewer noodles. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの料理を麺少なめでお受けします。内容を確認してご注文いただき、ありがとうございます。どうぞお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Certainly. We will prepare this dish with fewer noodles. Thank you for checking the details before ordering. Please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: おはようございます。洗浄を始める前に、確認しておきたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check before starting the cleaning?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日、旭川の醸造現場で容器の洗浄を担当するよう言われました。このボトルを使うと思ったんですが、表示が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 容器洗浄を担当する予定だが、使うと思ったボトルの表示が読めないと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Today I was told to clean containers at the brewing site in Asahikawa. I thought I should use this bottle, but I cannot read its label.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that you are due to clean containers but cannot read the label on the bottle you thought you would use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 表示を確認するまで使わないでください。ボトルはどこから持って来ましたか。容器用の作業手順書は受け取っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do not use it until the label has been checked. Where did you bring the bottle from? Have you received the work instructions for the containers?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 床掃除の道具の横にあったものです。手順書はまだ受け取っていません。同じ洗浄剤なら使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 床掃除用品の横から持ってきて手順書は未受領で、同じ洗浄剤なら使えると思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: It was beside the floor-cleaning equipment. I have not received the instructions yet. I thought I could use it as long as it was a cleaning agent too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you brought it from beside the floor-cleaning supplies, have not received the instructions, and thought any cleaning agent would do. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 床用と食品に関わる容器用を、同じものと判断してはいけません。ボトルをそれ以上使わず、管理担当へ場所と表示を伝えて確認します。装置には触れましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You must not assume floor cleaner and cleaner for containers used with food are the same. Do not use the bottle any further; we will tell the person managing it where it was and what the label says to check. Have you touched the equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まだ触っていません。近くの機械が動いているので、洗う前に停止を確認するのは私の担当なのか、誰に頼むのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 装置は未操作で近くの機械は動いているため、停止の確認権限と担当者を知りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not touched it yet. A nearby machine is running, so I want to know whether checking that it has stopped before cleaning is my responsibility or whom I should ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have not operated the equipment and a nearby machine is running, so you want to know who has the authority and responsibility to check that it has stopped. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 停止や安全確認は権限と手順を確認して行います。自分の判断で操作せず、責任者に担当範囲を聞きましょう。今日洗う容器は、指定を受けていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Stopping equipment and safety checks must follow confirmed procedures and authority. Do not operate anything on your own judgment; ask the supervisor about your responsibilities. Have you been told which containers to clean today?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この列の全部だと思っていましたが、作業済みの札もあります。洗う対象を責任者と一つずつ確認してから始めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 列全体が対象だと思ったが作業済みの札もあるので、責任者と洗浄対象を個別に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: I thought it was all the containers in this row, but some have tags saying the work is complete. I would like to check each container to be cleaned with the supervisor before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you thought the whole row was included, but some containers have completed-work tags, so you want to check them individually with the supervisor. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それが必要です。対象の札、指定された洗浄剤、装置の安全確認、担当者をそろえて確認しましょう。わからない表示はその場で聞いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: That is necessary. Let us check the tags on the containers, the specified cleaner, equipment safety checks, and who is responsible together. Ask on the spot about any label you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ボトルも装置も使わずに待ちます。洗う対象、手順書、指定品と安全確認の担当を聞き、自分の担当範囲がわかってから作業します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 表示不明のボトルと装置は使わず、対象、手順書、指定品、安全確認の担当と自分の範囲が明確になるまで待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will wait without using either the bottle or the equipment. I will ask which containers to clean, for the instructions and specified product, and who performs the safety checks, then work once I understand my responsibilities.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will not use the bottle with the unclear label or the equipment and will wait until the containers, instructions, specified product, person responsible for safety checks, and your own responsibilities are clear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 責任者を呼んで一緒に確認します。確認まで作業は始めないでください。使う前に相談してくれてありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will call the supervisor so we can check together. Please do not start work until we have checked. Thank you for consulting us before using it. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。防災についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Are you here to discuss disaster preparedness?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 旭川の会社の寮で避難訓練をしたいです。外国人の住人が多いので、消防署で相談できることを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 外国人が多い会社寮で避難訓練をしたいので、消防署で相談できる支援範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to hold an evacuation drill at our company dormitory in Asahikawa. Many residents are foreigners, so please tell me what we can consult the fire station about.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what support you can discuss with the fire station for an evacuation drill at a company dormitory with many foreign residents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 寮の管理者としてのご相談ですか。それとも、住んでいる方からのご相談でしょうか。今いちばん困っている点は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Are you consulting us as the dormitory manager, or as someone who lives there? What is causing the most difficulty right now?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 私は住人で、管理者ではありません。避難場所の掲示がありますが、日本語だけなので、どの道で行くのかわからない人がいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 自分は管理者でなく住人で、日本語だけの掲示では経路が分からない人がいると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I am a resident, not the manager. There is a notice showing the evacuation site, but it is only in Japanese, so some people do not know which route to take.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you are a resident rather than the manager, and some people cannot understand the route from the Japanese-only notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 経路や集合場所は、寮の管理者にも確認する必要があります。相談の際は、掲示と建物内の案内を用意すると状況を伝えやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: You also need to check the route and assembly point with the dormitory manager. Having the notice and directions inside the building ready will make it easier to explain the situation when consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 管理者に確認してから相談します。住人だけで勝手に訓練の日を決めるより、夜勤の人も参加できるか管理者と調整した方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: まず管理者に確認し、住人だけで日程を決めず夜勤者の参加も調整すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will check with the manager before consulting you. Rather than residents deciding the drill date on our own, we should coordinate with the manager so night-shift workers can participate too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will first check with the manager and coordinate participation for night-shift workers rather than having residents decide the date themselves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。勤務時間の違いも伝えてください。消防署に相談できる内容と、担当窓口や手配条件は、案内担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Please explain the differences in working hours too. Let us ask the information staff what the fire station can advise on, the appropriate contact, and the conditions for making arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 相談のために、掲示の写真と住人の勤務時間の傾向をまとめたいです。個人名を出さず、伝わりにくい案内の箇所を示せばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 掲示写真と個人名を除いた勤務傾向を整理し、伝わりにくい箇所を相談資料に示してよいか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: For the consultation, I would like to put together photos of the notices and an overview of residents' working hours. Is it okay to leave out individual names and indicate which parts of the directions are difficult to understand?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Check whether you can prepare notice photos and working-hour patterns without personal names and show unclear parts in the consultation materials. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まずは状況がわかる範囲で整理してください。詳しい情報が必要なら担当者が確認します。翻訳だけでなく、経路を実際に確かめる方法も相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: First, organize enough information to explain the situation. The person in charge will check if more details are needed. You can ask about ways to check the actual route, as well as translation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 管理者に経路と集合場所を確認し、掲示でわからない所と夜勤の事情をまとめます。そのうえで相談窓口と訓練の手配方法を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 管理者に経路と集合場所を確かめ、掲示の不明点と夜勤事情を整理して相談窓口と手配方法を尋ねると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will check the route and assembly point with the manager and summarize the unclear parts of the notices and the night-shift situation. Then I will ask whom to consult and how to arrange a drill.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will check the route and assembly point with the manager, organize unclear notice details and night-shift circumstances, and ask about the consultation contact and arrangements. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内担当へおつなぎします。寮内の調整と相談内容を分けて準備してみてください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. I will put you through to the information staff. Try preparing the coordination within the dormitory separately from the matters you want advice on. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: おはようございます。包装工程で、何か確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Good morning. Is there anything you want to check in the packaging process?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 旭川の工場で包装を担当しています。このラベルの品名と、手元の作業票の品名が違うので、そのまま貼っていいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 包装ラベルと作業票の品名が一致せず、そのまま貼り続けてよいか確認したいと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I handle packaging at a factory in Asahikawa. The product name on this label differs from the one on my work sheet, so I am unsure whether to keep applying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Report that the product names on the packaging label and work sheet do not match, and you want to check whether you may continue applying the labels. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 不一致があるなら、貼付けを始めずに確認します。そのラベルは、すでに何かの製品へ貼りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: If they do not match, we should check before starting to apply labels. Have you already applied that label to any products?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 数個貼ってから気づきました。何個だったか正確には覚えていません。貼った分を全部はがせばいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 数個は貼ったが正確な数は不明で、自分で全てはがしてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I noticed after applying a few. I do not remember exactly how many. Should I peel off all the ones I applied?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you applied a few but do not know the exact number, and ask whether you may remove them all yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 自分の判断ではがさないでください。担当者が対象を確認できるよう、貼った製品の流れと、気づいた時点を伝えましょう。製品はどこへ進みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Please do not remove them on your own judgment. Tell us where the labeled products went and when you noticed, so the person in charge can identify the affected items. Where have the products gone?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この箱には残っていますが、一部は次の工程へ渡しました。数量がわからなくても、箱の表示と渡した相手を報告すればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 手元の箱と次工程へ渡った製品を分け、数が不明でも箱表示と渡した相手を報告できると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Some are still in this box, but I handed some over to the next process. Even if I do not know the quantity, should I report the box markings and whom I handed them to?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Distinguish the box you still have from products passed to the next process, and say you can report the box markings and recipient even though the number is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、わかる情報と不明な情報を分けて報告してください。次の工程にも担当者から連絡します。対象を識別するまで、ほかの製品と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please report what you know separately from what you do not know. The person in charge will also contact the next process. We will keep them separate from other products until the affected items have been identified.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手元の箱はそのままにして、表示と時刻をメモします。包装を止める操作は、私が勝手にせず、工程の責任者に頼んだ方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 箱を保全し表示と時刻を記録して、停止操作の担当は工程の責任者に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will leave the box here as it is and note its markings and the time. For operating the packaging stop controls, should I ask the process supervisor rather than doing it myself without permission?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will preserve the box and record its markings and the time, and want to check with the process supervisor who is responsible for stopping the equipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 工場で決められた異常時の手順に従って、停止と連絡の担当を確認してください。対象範囲や再開は責任者が確認します。操作が不明なら触らず知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Follow the factory's abnormality procedures and check who is responsible for stopping equipment and making contact. The supervisor will confirm the affected scope and restarting. If you are unsure how to operate something, do not touch it; report it.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 貼付けを進めず、作業票とラベル、箱の表示、渡した相手を報告します。数量不明も伝え、停止と製品の扱いは決められた手順で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 貼付けを進めずラベル、作業票、箱、渡した相手、数量不明を報告し、停止と製品の扱いは所定手順で確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will not continue labeling and will report the work sheet, label, box markings, and whom I handed the products to. I will also say the quantity is unknown and follow the established procedures to check about stopping and handling the products.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will stop applying labels, report the label, work sheet, box, recipient, and unknown quantity, and check the required procedures for stopping and handling the products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。責任者と次工程への確認を進めます。再開の指示までは作業を進めないでください。早く知らせてくれてありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. We will check with the supervisor and the next process. Do not proceed with work until instructed to restart. Thank you for reporting this promptly. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。列車の遅れで、どのようなことでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. What difficulty is the train delay causing you?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 乗る予定の列車が遅れていて、その先で予約した列車に間に合うか心配です。旭川からの移動予定を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 遅れている列車から別の予約列車に接続できるか心配なので、移動予定を確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: The train I plan to take is delayed, and I am worried about making the train I reserved for the next part of my journey. Could you look at my travel plans from Asahikawa?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask to have your travel plans checked because you are worried whether you can connect from the delayed train to another reserved train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 予約の区間と乗り換える駅を確認しましょう。遅れている列車と、その先の予約は同じ切符に記載されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Let us check your reserved journey and transfer station. Are the delayed train and the later reservation shown on the same ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 別々に予約しています。乗り換える駅はこの確認画面にありますが、そこまでの到着予定をまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 二つは別予約で乗換駅は画面にあるが、そこまでの到着見込みは未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: I booked them separately. The transfer station is on this confirmation screen, but I have not checked the expected arrival time there yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that the two bookings are separate and the transfer station is on the screen, but you have not checked the expected arrival time there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: まず遅れている列車の案内を確認します。表示の見込みは変わる場合があるので、接続できるとお約束はできません。予約列車の変更条件はご存じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: First, I will check the information for the delayed train. The displayed estimate may change, so I cannot promise you will make the connection. Do you know the conditions for changing your reserved train?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 知りません。間に合わないと思って予約を消そうとしましたが、払い戻しの条件がわからないので、まだ操作していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 間に合わないと思って取消しを考えたが、払い戻し条件が不明なのでまだ操作していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: No. I was going to delete the reservation because I thought I would not make it, but I have not done anything yet because I do not know the refund conditions.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you considered canceling because you thought you would not make it, but have not taken any action because the refund conditions are unclear. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 削除や取り消しを進める前に、その予約の条件と相談先を確認してください。遅延時の扱いも、予約方法や切符によって確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Before deleting or canceling it, please check that reservation's conditions and whom to consult. The arrangements for delays also need checking according to the booking method and ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: わかりました。まず到着見込みと変更の相談先を聞きます。待ち合わせ相手には、到着時刻がまだ決まらないと連絡しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 到着見込みと変更の相談先を先に確認し、待合せ相手には時刻が未確定だと知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. First, I will ask about the expected arrival time and whom to consult about changes. I will let the person I am meeting know my arrival time is still uncertain.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will first check the expected arrival time and the contact for changes, and tell the person you are meeting that the time is not yet certain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。相手には確定していないことを伝えるとよいですね。予約画面と遅延案内を担当者に示し、変更が必要かを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. It is a good idea to tell them the time is not confirmed. Let us show the person in charge your reservation screen and delay information and check whether a change is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 予約は取り消さずに残して、二つの予約と遅延表示を見せます。接続と変更条件を確認してから、次に乗る列車を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 二予約と遅延表示を示し、すぐ取消さず接続と変更条件を確認して次の列車を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will keep the reservations without canceling and show both bookings and the delay display. I will decide which train to take next after checking the connection and conditions for changes.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will show both bookings and the delay display, check the connection and change conditions without canceling immediately, then decide on the next train. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。案内担当へ確認しましょう。見込みが変わったら改めてご案内しますので、無理に急がずお待ちください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-06-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. Let us check with the information staff. We will let you know again if the estimate changes, so please wait without rushing. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計のことで確認されたいことはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to check about your bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 旭川のこのカウンターで食べた分を確認したいです。皿の色が同じだったので全部同じ値段だと思っていましたが、明細の見方がわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 同じ皿色なら同価格と思っていたが明細が分からず、食事の内訳を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I would like to check what I ate at this counter in Asahikawa. The plates were the same color, so I thought everything cost the same, but I do not understand how to read the itemized bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you thought plates of the same color had the same price, but do not understand the itemized bill and want to check the breakdown of your meal. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 皿の色だけで価格を決めず、注文した内容と明細を確認しましょう。何を召し上がったか、覚えているものから教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Rather than determining the price by plate color alone, let us check what you ordered against the itemized bill. Could you tell me what you ate, starting with anything you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 店内で食べたもののほかに、家族への持ち帰りも頼みました。明細の数量に持ち帰り分も入っているのか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 店内の食事と家族用の持帰り注文があり、明細数量に両方が含まれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Besides what I ate here, I also ordered takeout for my family. I want to know whether the quantities on the itemized bill include the takeout too.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain that you ate in and ordered takeout for your family, and ask whether the itemized quantities include both. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 店内分と持ち帰り分を分けて注文記録と照合します。持ち帰りは同じ会計にまとめるつもりでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: We will separate the dine-in and takeout items and check them against the order record. Did you intend to pay for the takeout on the same bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ会計で構いませんが、会社に出すのは自分の食事分だけです。家族の分と区別できる形で内容を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会計はまとめてよいが会社へ出すのは本人の食事分だけなので、家族分と区別したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: The same bill is fine, but only my own meal is for submission to my company. I want to check the details in a way that distinguishes my family's portion.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say one bill is fine, but you want to distinguish your family's items because only your own meal will be submitted to your company. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 区別して確認したいんですね。明細や領収書をどのような形で出せるか確認します。会社の精算に必要な条件は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: You would like to distinguish them when checking. I will check what format we can provide for the itemized bill and receipt. Has your company specified any requirements for reimbursement?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 会社の条件はまだ聞いていません。分けた領収書を必ず出せるとは限らないので、先に会社へ必要な形式を聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 会社の精算条件は未確認で、店が領収書を分けられると決めつけず必要形式を先に聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have not asked my company about its requirements yet. Since separate receipts may not necessarily be possible, may I first ask my company what format it needs?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you have not checked the company's reimbursement requirements and want to ask about the required format first, without assuming the restaurant can issue separate receipts. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。こちらでできる対応も確認しますので、必要な形式がわかったらお伝えください。注文内容の内訳は先に一緒に照合できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. We will also check what we can do, so please tell us once you know the required format. We can check the breakdown of the order together first.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: まず店内分と持ち帰り分の注文を確認します。会社には精算条件を聞き、お店で対応できる形式がわかってから領収書をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 二種類の注文を照合し、会社の条件と店の発行可能な形式を確かめてから領収書を依頼すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: First, I will check the dine-in and takeout orders. I will ask my company about reimbursement requirements and request a receipt after finding out what format the restaurant can provide.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will check both types of orders and confirm the company's requirements and the receipt formats the restaurant can issue before requesting a receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 承知しました。内訳をご案内してから会計と書類の扱いを確認します。ご利用ありがとうございました。持ち帰り品もお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-07-001-SHARED-1.translation: Understood. We will explain the breakdown, then check how to handle payment and the paperwork. Thank you for dining with us. Please remember your takeout too.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こんにちは。書類の発送についてご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Hello. Are you here to discuss mailing documents?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 旭川から応募書類を送りたいです。締切の日に出せばいいと思っていたんですが、この案内には『必着』と書いてあります。どういう意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 応募書類は締切日に発送すればよいと思ったが、必着とあるので意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I want to send application documents from Asahikawa. I thought I just needed to send them on the deadline date, but this information says 'must arrive by.' What does that mean?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you thought you could mail the application documents on the deadline date, but ask what 'must arrive by' means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 『必着』は、その日までに相手へ届くことを求める表現です。出した日の消印でよいという意味ではありません。締切と送り先を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: 'Must arrive by' means the recipient needs to receive them by that date. It does not mean a postmark from the day you send them is enough. Can you show me the deadline and destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 締切はこの書類にあります。送り先は遠方なので、今日出して間に合うか心配です。追跡が付いていれば、必ず間に合いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 送り先は遠方で今日出して間に合うか心配なため、追跡があれば到着を保証できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: The deadline is on this document. The destination is far away, so I am worried whether they will arrive in time if I send them today. If tracking is included, are they guaranteed to arrive in time?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say the destination is far away and you are worried about sending them today, and ask whether tracking guarantees arrival by the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 追跡できることと、締切までの到着は別です。利用できる発送方法と配達の見込みを確認しますが、到着を必ず保証できるとは限りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Being able to track the shipment is separate from arriving by the deadline. We will check the available mailing methods and estimated delivery, but we may not be able to guarantee arrival.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: では、速さだけでなく、届いたかを確認する方法も知りたいです。提出先が受け取りの記録を求めているかも、案内を読み直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 速さだけでなく到着確認の記録も知りたく、提出先が求める記録を読み直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I would like to know not only about speed but also how to confirm delivery. I will reread the instructions to see whether the organization requires a record of receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you want to know about delivery confirmation records as well as speed, and will reread what records the recipient requires. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい。必要な記録の種類を確認してから発送方法を選びましょう。締切に余裕がなければ、提出先に別の提出方法があるか尋ねることも考えられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes. Let us check what type of record is required before choosing a mailing method. If there is little time before the deadline, you could also consider asking the recipient whether there is another submission method.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 提出先に電話して、郵送以外で受け付けるか聞きます。こちらでは、選べる方法の配達見込みと記録の違いを教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 提出先に郵送以外の方法を確認し、窓口では各発送方法の配達見込みと記録の違いを聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: I will call the recipient and ask whether they accept submissions other than by mail. Here, could you tell me the estimated delivery times and differences in records for the available methods?
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you will ask the recipient about methods other than mail and want the counter staff to explain estimated delivery times and records for each shipping method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 承知しました。送り先と受付時点の案内を確認してご説明します。提出先の返答が来るまでは、封筒を差し出さずに比較していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-0.translation: Certainly. I will check the destination and the information available at the time of acceptance and explain. Until the recipient replies, you can compare the options without handing over the envelope for mailing.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: 発送はまだせず、提出先の方法と必要記録を確認します。その返答と配達見込みを比べて、書類が締切までに届く方法を選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 発送は保留し、提出先の回答と必要記録、配達見込みを比較して期限に合う方法を選びたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: I will hold off on mailing and check the recipient's submission methods and required records. I would like to compare their reply with the delivery estimates and choose a method that gets the documents there by the deadline.
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you will hold off on sending, compare the recipient's reply, required records, and estimated delivery, and choose a method that meets the deadline. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: はい。まず送り先と締切の案内を拝見します。追跡の有無だけで決めずに確認していきましょう。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-HKD-ASAHIKAWA-08-001-SHARED-1.translation: Yes. First, let me see the destination and deadline instructions. Let us check without deciding on tracking alone. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: おはようございます。仕分けを始める前に、困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-01.translation: Good morning. Is anything troubling you before you start sorting?

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つの箱の魚は同じに見えます。函館の仕分け場で働くのは初めてなので、どの表示を見て分けるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 見た目が似ている二つの魚の箱を、どの表示で仕分ければよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-02.translation: The fish in these two boxes look the same. This is my first time working at the sorting site in Hakodate, so please tell me which markings to check to separate them.
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which markings to use to sort two boxes of fish that look similar. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外見だけで判断せず、作業票と荷札を照合します。箱についている荷札の文字は読めますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than judging by appearance alone, we compare the work sheet and shipping tags. Can you read the writing on the tags attached to the boxes?

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片方は水でぬれて、文字がにじんでいます。同じ種類なら隣の箱と一緒にしていいのかと思っていました。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 片方の荷札が水でにじんで読めないことと、魚が同じ種類なら混ぜてもよいと思っていたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-04.translation: One tag is wet and the writing has run. I thought I could put it together with the neighboring box if the fish were the same kind.
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one shipping tag is water-damaged and unreadable, and you thought the boxes could be mixed if the fish were the same kind. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 荷札が読めない箱は混ぜないでください。出荷先が違う可能性もあるので、担当者が確認するまで保留にします。箱は動かしましたか。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please do not mix in a box whose tag cannot be read. The destination may be different, so we will put it on hold until the person in charge checks it. Have you moved the box?

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだ動かしていません。このままだと運搬の通路に近いので、保留にする場所を確認してから移したいです。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱はまだ動かしていないが通路に近いため、移す前に保留品の置き場を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not moved it yet. It is close to the transport passageway where it is, so I would like to check the holding area before moving it.
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not moved the box, but it is near a passageway, so you want to check where held items go before moving it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保留品の指定場所を確認します。移す前に重量と運び方も確かめましょう。一人で持てるか迷う重さですか。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the designated holding area. Let us also check the weight and how to carry it before moving it. Is it heavy enough that you are unsure whether you can lift it alone?

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持ち上げようとしたら重かったので、やめました。台車を使うか、二人で運ぶか指示してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 重かったので持ち上げるのをやめたと報告し、台車を使うか二人で運ぶか指示を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-08.translation: I tried to lift it, but it was heavy, so I stopped. Could you tell me whether to use a cart or carry it with two people?
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you stopped trying to lift it because it was heavy, and ask for instructions on using a cart or carrying it with two people. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 持ち上げるのを止めて正解です。台車の使用と移動経路を担当者に確認し、箱が滑らない置き方も教えてもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-09.translation: You were right to stop lifting it. Let us ask the person in charge about using a cart and the transport route, and have them show us how to position the box so it does not slip.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 読めない荷札の箱は混ぜずに保留します。重量、台車、指定場所を確認してから運び、荷札の確認が済むまで仕分けません。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 読めない荷札の箱は混ぜず、重量と運び方、指定場所を確認してから移し、確認が済むまで仕分けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the box with the unreadable tag separate and on hold. I will carry it after checking the weight, cart, and designated location, and will not sort it until the tag has been checked.
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the box with the unreadable tag separate, move it after checking its weight, carrying method, and designated location, and not sort it until it has been checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。まず担当者を呼びますので、箱には手をつけずここで待ってください。早めの報告、ありがとうございます。引き続きよろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-HKD-HAKODATE-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. I will call the person in charge first, so please wait here without touching the box. Thank you for reporting this promptly. Thank you for your continued cooperation.
